overview_description.description: Zywa provides a digital financial platform designed to help younger users manage their money. The company offers tools that enable spending, saving, and earning through a mobile app tailored for Gen Z users and supported by parental access. Its platform includes spending insights, transaction notifications, and bill payment features with cashback incentives. The service incorporates security measures such as 3D Secure standards and automated fraud monitoring to protect user transactions.

about_short_description.short_description: Zywa provides a mobile banking app and prepaid card for Gen Z to manage money, set goals, and track spending.

product.name: Zywa Mobile Banking App
product.description: A mobile app that allows Gen Z users to manage money, set spending limits, track expenses, and send or receive money instantly.

product.name: Zywa Flashy Card
product.description: A prepaid card linked to the Zywa app that can be frozen or blocked for specific brands and used to make payments with offers on popular brands.

product.name: Parental Account and Card Management
product.description: A service that enables parents to create accounts and issue Zywa cards to their children for managing pocket money securely.

product.name: Money Transfer and Bill Splitting
product.description: A feature within the Zywa app that enables users to send and receive money instantly and split bills among friends or family.

identifier.value: Spending Tracking and Monthly Spend Limits

product.name: Spending Tracking and Monthly Spend Limits
product.description: Tools within the Zywa app that track monthly spending and automatically freeze the card when preset spending limits are reached.

product.name: Cashbacks on Bill Payments
product.description: A feature that offers users cashbacks when they pay bills through the Zywa app.
